name: glassport
description: Control a paired iPad in a local browser and bring native text, sketches and exported files into Codex.

interface.longDescription: Bring a paired physical iPad into a local browser pane. See and control its apps, type from your laptop, paste Unicode and multiline text, retrieve native copied text, capture sketches and notes, and import supported app exports. Glassport runs locally on an Apple Silicon Mac and uses a trusted iPad with iPadOS 27 or later and Developer Mode. Tailscale connects the paired devices; first-time pairing may require a one-time USB trust step. The Codex skill operates the same browser interface as the user. Private device state, pairing records and exports remain in the local installation. Audio and distinct-network routed operation are not certified in this preview. No OCR or emulator is used. Original project code is MIT; the adapted native bridge retains GPL-3.0-or-later.
capabilities: Display and control a physical iPad
Type and paste into iPad apps
defaultPrompt: Use Glassport to open my iPad.
